title: Collectables - Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase Guide
subtitle: How to start {quest} in Burning Springs, how the hand-ins to Bodhi work, and what you get for them.

sections.title: Finding Them
sections.html:
{finding_sentence}

  • Listen for them. Every briefcase makes a radar-like beeping sound that gets louder the closer you get.
  • Look for the light. At night, or in dark places, a bright red light near the handle makes them easier to spot.
  • Follow the route. The location pages follow one numbered route, and most spawns lead straight to the next.
  • Track the challenge. Open the Challenges menu, find the Abraxodyne Intel lifetime challenge and press Track: your count then shows in the Challenges box on the map.
  • Where they go. A briefcase goes into your Pip-Boy as {item_name} in the Misc tab, and stays there until you hand it in to Bodhi.
  • They're yours only. {item_name} can't be dropped, traded or sold.
  • One per character. Once you pick one up, it won't respawn for that character.
  • XP. Each briefcase is worth a base of 10 XP, and each Abraxodyne Cache a base of 50 XP.

sections.title: How to Start {quest}
sections.html:
There are two ways in. Either one starts {quest}.

Option 1 – Pick up any Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase

{img:questline-briefcase-message}

Option 2 – Go to Athens

{img:questline-athens-legal-office}

sections.title: {quest} Walkthrough
sections.html:
Step 1 – Go to the Legal Office in Athens

The quest sends you to Abraxodyne Chemical’s Legal Office in Athens. Follow the quest marker and enter through the green door.

{img:questline-legal-office-map}

Step 2 – Speak to Bodhi

Inside is an NPC named Bodhi. He asks for briefcases in return for lore holotapes.

Step 3 – Collect briefcases and hand them in

Bring them back to Bodhi in batches: see Handing In Briefcases to Bodhi below. Once you have handed in all {batch_count} batches, {quest} is done.

{img:questline-collect-intel,questline-return-to-bodhi}

sections.title: Handing In Briefcases to Bodhi
sections.html:
Take your briefcases to Bodhi at Abraxodyne Chemical’s Legal Office in Athens. He takes them in {batch_count} hand-ins and gives you a lore holotape for each one:

{batch_table}

That is {quest_total} briefcases for the whole quest. You can turn them in as you go or save them up and hand them in all at once: the game still counts the total and gives you a holotape for every hand-in your briefcases cover.

sections.title: Quest Rewards
sections.html:
• Finishing {quest} pays {caps} caps, {xp} XP, {plan} and a Burning Springs loot roll.
  • Each hand-in gives you one of the {batch_count} Abraxodyne Tapes.
  • Each briefcase you pick up is worth a base of 10 XP.
  • The three Abraxodyne Caches give more rewards: Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase Cache Locations 1 - 3.

Every reward, with tick boxes: Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase Reward Checklist.

sections.title: FAQ and Important Info
sections.html:
Will I still receive the lifetime rewards on a Custom World?

Yes, but the rewards will not carry over to Adventure mode. If you switch to Adventure, the challenges will appear as 0, and you will need to collect all the briefcases again.

Do I have to start the questline to unlock all the rewards?

Yes and No. You don’t need to start the questline to unlock the lifetime challenge rewards and weapons.

There are 148 briefcase spawns in the world, and the final lifetime reward, the Prototype ABX03, unlocks at 145 collected. That means you can earn every lifetime challenge reward and weapon from world spawns alone, without the caches. The caches grant three bonus briefcases each (currently bugged) and their keys only come from completing the Dirty Laundry questline, so they are optional for the rewards.

There’s also a separate lifetime challenge for completing the questline itself, so whether you do it depends on whether you want those additional rewards.
